## Statements & failure conditions

### OPN-001 — Formalize Co-Admissibility (Task 0.1)

Define co-admissibility as a criterion C(constraints) → admissible set that is well-defined, computable, and measure-independent (no free entanglement measure).

*Risk if false:* The gating task. If no formalization avoids a free measure, or every one reduces to the einselection optimization, BOTH physics conjectures (PRD-001, PRD-002) lose discriminating content and the programme collapses to re-description.

### OPN-002 — Actualization-Resolution Keystone

Characterize how A resolves unsatisfiable/unresolved admissible structure: obstruction-registering (linear → GR, projective measurement-free) or best-fit projective (quadratic → modified gravity, projective measurement).

*Risk if false:* Shared root of the Born-rule (2.2) and gravity (3.1) forks. If A is best-fit with an imposed norm, the linear/GR route closes.

### OPN-003 — Derivation / Recovery of Known Physics

Reconstruct the familiar structures — Hilbert space, probability, the Born rule, gauge symmetry, relativistic spacetime, field equations, conservation laws — from the triadic foundation, in appropriate limits.

*Risk if false:* If no known physics is recovered in any limit, TRT remains ontology, not physics.

### OPN-004 — Derivation of the Born Measure

Derive the Born rule's form from constraints on actualizing action A across the admissible→actual boundary, rather than assuming it; and address the hard residue (why one admissible branch actualizes rather than another on a given occasion).

*Risk if false:* If the measure must be assumed, TRT inherits the measurement problem's hard core unchanged (as conceded).

### OPN-005 — Dimensional Analysis (ontological A vs physical S)

Develop the relation between ontological action A, the physical action functional S, energy, and time; justify the inference from the prominence of S in physics to the ontological role of A (the S→A bridge).

*Risk if false:* Without the S→A bridge, the variational apparatus and the energy-as-action-rate identification stay metaphorical.

### OPN-006 — Avoid Equivocation (define terms before use)

Logic, information, and action carry different meanings across disciplines. TRT must fix its terms before deploying them. Standing methodological discipline, not a one-time resolvable result.

*Risk if false:* Equivocation silently smuggles unearned content across the formal/physical/metaphysical boundary.

### OPN-007 — Theology / Metaphysics Boundary Discipline

Keep formal, physical, and metaphysical claims distinct; state the one explicit posit (actuality is a genuine status distinct from possibility, §9.3) openly. Disclosure is the standard, not the absence of metaphysical commitment.

*Risk if false:* An unannounced metaphysical posit operating as if it were physics would breach the methodology.

### OPN-008 — ADCE — Dark Energy from Mean Causal Growth

Determine whether the mean growth rate of realized causal structure (Ṅ), on the causal-set number-volume substrate with an explicit saturation axiom (A-SAT), can drive late-time accelerated expansion with (a) a derived growth law producing matter-era deceleration followed by acceleration onset at z ≈ 0.7, (b) a natural magnitude compatible with the observed dark-energy scale, and (c) a w_A(z) distinguishable from both ΛCDM and the fluctuation-driven everpresent-Λ mechanism (Λ ~ ±ℏ/√V₄) that shares the same kinematic substrate.

*Risk if false:* If no growth law solves the coincidence problem without hand-tuning, or the mechanism cannot match the fluctuation rival's derived 10^-120 magnitude, or the 4-volume resolution renders the geometric hypothesis vacuous (static universes sustain Ṅ > 0 at saturation, so only *accelerating* actualization carries content — adce.md §8 v3.1), or no N_R→N_P bridge law can be stated (adce.md §9.4), ADCE reduces to re-labeled causal-set kinematics with no independent content and is abandoned (adce.md §16 criteria 11-12, 15-16). The TRT hard core is untouched either way; this is a belt-level physics-facing conjecture.

### OPN-009 — Operationalize and Attempt to Falsify the TRT-FLL Physical Hypothesis

Govern the empirical investigation of TRT's physical hypothesis chi = A(I \| L), presently an ontological schema in which L is the global physical admissibility constraint, not yet a dynamical or operational law. The model predicts that every physical informational actualization satisfies Identity, Non-Contradiction, and Excluded Middle, with operational consequence V(P_chi) in {T,F}. One reproducible, irreducible B or N actualization for the same proposition, context, time, and respect falsifies the model's exclusion rule that non-bivalent information is absent from the physically actualizable state space. The derived Global Bivalent Closure witness, rival-model constructions, and the empirical falsification ledger are subordinate instruments for exposing the model to failure rather than substitutes for it. Law status is intended but not earned. Purpose-built negative tests add implementation-relative corroboration in proportion to their power to expose B or N; adjacent quantum-foundational results merely constrain nearby rivals unless they had that power.

*Risk if false:* If no instrument can implement proposition-dual independent records, or every apparent violation is observationally equivalent to a calibrated common-mode failure, the global bivalent-closure bridge under FLL remains empirically inaccessible. If a sound implementation violates the bound after all auxiliary assumptions survive, the claim that completed actual contexts are globally bivalent is refuted and TRT's L3-to-outcome-actual bridge requires revision.
